source: Ballotpedia (ballotpedia.org) — Tier 2 corroboration source; acknowledged as a source per founder, 2026-09-22
method: Live fetches (maxAge 0) of each Ballotpedia election page; only the 'General election' block for Nov 3, 2026 was extracted (primary fields ignored). Party codes normalized: R→REP, D→DEM, L→LPF, 'No Party Affiliation'→NPA. Names matched loosely (nicknames, middle names/initials, suffixes); name-form variants are listed under diff.name_variants, not as mismatches. Ballotpedia is Tier 2: discrepancies below are reports, not corrections. Nothing was written to the database.

races.notes: DISCREPANCY (Tier 2 report, not a correction). Ballotpedia's general-election table lists three candidates; ours lists two. The third, Kyle Gibson, exists in our candidate table as a qualified WRITE-IN (party WRI), which by design is not in the race's ballot roster. Ballotpedia presents him as an on-ballot NPA candidate with no write-in tag (https://ballotpedia.org/Florida_Agriculture_Commissioner_election,_2026; https://ballotpedia.org/Kyle_Gibson). Context from his Ballotpedia page: in 2022 he ran for Governor as a write-in and 'was removed from the ballot prior to the general election.' Whether Gibson is a qualified write-in or an on-ballot NPA candidate should be settled by the Tier 1 source (FL Division of Elections); this file only records that Ballotpedia and our data classify him differently. Ballotpedia also lists Joey Atkins among withdrawn candidates of the U.S. Senate Democratic primary (https://ballotpedia.org/United_States_Senate_special_election_in_Florida,_2026), consistent with him having moved to this race. Withdrawn under the Democratic primary heading: Chase Anderson Romagnano (D) — primary-level, not included above. Page caveat: 'The candidate list in this election may not be complete.'

Our race record (office 'United States Senator', level federal) carries no special-election marker — an observation, not a candidate mismatch. Ballotpedia lists Pano Churchill (NPA) as withdrawn under the general-election heading (included above with withdrawn=true; no row for him in our candidate table). measures_summary: Ballotpedia's 'On the ballot' table for Florida 2026 lists exactly three measures, all LRCAs, corresponding one-to-one with our three (https://ballotpedia.org/Florida_2026_ballot_measures). No measure is only-on-Ballotpedia or only-in-ours. Ballotpedia numbers only Amendment 3; the other two are unnumbered there.
